hooks.command:
if ! command -v 1xops >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s
' '{"systemMessage":"1xops is not installed, so connectors were not checked. Install: uv tool install 1xops (or npm install -g 1xops)"}'; elif out=$(1xops doctor --hook --within 4 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s
' "$out"; else printf '%s
' '{"systemMessage":"1xops could not check the connectors (an older 1xops, or an error). Run: 1xops doctor"}'; fi
